verdict.rationale: Cerebras Inference is delivered exclusively as a cloud API/console service running on proprietary wafer-scale hardware; the only 'private' option mentioned is a Cerebras-managed 'dedicated endpoint' (still hosted by Cerebras, not on customer infrastructure), and no evidence anywhere describes downloadable software, on-prem deployment, or open weights/binaries a user could run themselves. Missing for 10: any documentation of on-prem/self-managed deployment, open-source release of the inference stack, or hardware/software customers can install in their own environment.
